/* --- Category contacts --- */
.cat-contacts {background: var(--surface-subtle); padding: var(--section-py-base, 96px) 0; }
.cat-contacts__layout {display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--sp-8); align-items: stretch; }
.cat-contacts__info {display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; }
.contact-item {display: flex; gap: var(--sp-4); padding: var(--sp-5) 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); text-decoration: none; }
.cat-contacts__info .contact-item:first-child {padding-top: 0; }
.cat-contacts__info .contact-item:last-child {border-bottom: 0; }
.contact-item__icon {width: 44px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--teal-50); color: var(--teal-600); }
.contact-item__icon svg {width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.contact-item__label {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-bottom: var(--sp-1); }
.contact-item__value {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h4); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); color: var(--text-primary); line-height: 1.3; }
.contact-item__value--sm {font-size: var(--fs-body); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); line-height: var(--lh-tight); }
a.contact-item:hover .contact-item__value {color: var(--text-brand); }
.contact-item__meta {font-size: var(--fs-small); color: var(--text-tertiary); margin-top: var(--sp-1); }
.cat-contacts__map {height: 100%; min-height: 460px; background: var(--neutral-100); overflow: hidden; border: 0; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.cat-contacts__map iframe {width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; display: block; }
/* --- Category page responsive --- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .cat-hero { min-height: 520px; }
  .cat-hero__overlay {
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg,
        rgba(10,28,37,0.85) 0%,
        rgba(10,28,37,0.7) 50%,
        rgba(10,28,37,0.85) 100%);
  }
  .subcat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .adv__grid--6 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .cat-contacts__layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .subcat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .subcat-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .adv__grid--6 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cat-hero__actions { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .cat-hero__actions .btn { justify-content: center; }
}
/* ============================================================
   LEADGEN (категория): фото менеджера с плашкой + форма сбоку
   ============================================================ */
.leadgen__grid {align-items: stretch; }
.leadgen__photo {position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-muted); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); min-height: 520px; }
.leadgen__photo > img {position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 22%; }
.leadgen__plaque {position: absolute; left: var(--sp-6); right: var(--sp-6); bottom: var(--sp-6); background: var(--surface-page); padding: var(--sp-5) var(--sp-7); border-left: 3px solid var(--teal-600); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.leadgen__plaque-eyebrow {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-brand); margin-bottom: var(--sp-2); }
.leadgen__plaque-title {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h3); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: var(--ls-h3); color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: var(--sp-2); }
.leadgen__plaque-title em {font-style: normal; color: var(--text-brand); }
.leadgen__plaque-text {font-size: var(--fs-small); line-height: 1.45; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.leadgen__plaque-attr {display: flex; align-items: center; margin-top: var(--sp-3); padding-top: var(--sp-2); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-caption); color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.leadgen__plaque-attr strong {color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .leadgen__photo { min-height: 380px; }
  .leadgen__plaque {
    left: var(--sp-4); right: var(--sp-4); bottom: var(--sp-4);
    padding: var(--sp-5);
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   WHY-US — тёмная шапка + шахматная плитка карточек
   ============================================================ */
.why-us {background: var(--surface-page); }
.why-us__hero {background: var(--neutral-950); color: var(--text-inverse); padding: var(--sp-20) 0 0; }
.why-us__hero > .container {padding-bottom: var(--sp-14); }
.why-us__image {position: relative; height: 460px; background: var(--neutral-950) url('/img/banner-service.png') center 30%/cover no-repeat; }
.why-us__image::after {content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg,
    rgba(16,31,38,0.55) 0%,
    rgba(16,31,38,0.15) 35%,
    rgba(16,31,38,0) 60%,
    rgba(16,31,38,0.10) 100%); pointer-events: none; }
.why-us__head {max-width: 860px; margin: 0 0 var(--sp-10); }
.why-us__eyebrow {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--green-400); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-3); margin-bottom: var(--sp-5); }
.why-us__eyebrow::before {content: ""; width: 32px; height: 2px; background: var(--green-400); }
.why-us__title {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 48px); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: var(--ls-h1); color: var(--text-inverse); margin-bottom: var(--sp-5); }
.why-us__title em {font-style: normal; color: var(--green-400); }
.why-us__lead {font-size: var(--fs-lead); line-height: var(--lh-body); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); max-width: 60ch; }
.why-us__tags {display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-3); padding-top: var(--sp-8); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
.why-us__tags-label {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow); text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-right: var(--sp-2); }
.why-us__tags-list {display: contents; }
.why-us__tags-list li {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-2); padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-4); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); font-size: var(--fs-small); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); }
.why-us__tags-list li::before {content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green-500); flex-shrink: 0; }
.why-us__cards-band {background: transparent; padding-bottom: var(--sp-20); margin-top: -240px; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.why-us__cards {display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.why-us-card {padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-7); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-4); background: var(--surface-page); color: var(--text-primary); min-height: 300px; position: relative; }
.why-us-card__num {font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-caption); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.why-us-card__icon {width: 64px; height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--teal-600); margin: var(--sp-2) 0; }
.why-us-card__icon svg {width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.why-us-card__title {font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--fs-h4); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: var(--ls-h3); }
.why-us-card__text {font-size: var(--fs-small); line-height: var(--lh-body); color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: auto; }
/* Тёмные карточки — шахматный порядок (2, 4, 6) */
.why-us-card:nth-child(2n) {background: var(--neutral-950); color: var(--text-inverse); }
.why-us-card:nth-child(2n) .why-us-card__num {color: var(--green-400); opacity: 0.85; }
.why-us-card:nth-child(2n) .why-us-card__icon {color: var(--green-400); }
.why-us-card:nth-child(2n) .why-us-card__text {color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .why-us__cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .why-us__hero { padding-top: var(--sp-16); }
  .why-us__image { height: 360px; }
  .why-us__cards-band { margin-top: -200px; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .why-us__cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .why-us__image { height: 240px; }
  .why-us__cards-band { margin-top: -120px; }
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .nav-toggle { display: inline-flex; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .header__actions .btn--primary { display: none; }
}
/* — Hero checklist (4 пункта над CTA) — */
.proj-hero__body {max-width: 760px; }
.proj-hero__checklist {list-style: none; margin: var(--sp-6) 0 var(--sp-8); padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-6); }
.proj-hero__checklist li {display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-3); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); font-size: var(--fs-body); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); }
.proj-hero__checklist svg {width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--green-400); flex-shrink: 0; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .proj-hero__checklist { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
/* ============================================================
   CASES — головной блок (intro + tabs + featured case)
   ============================================================ */
.cases {background: var(--neutral-0); padding: var(--section-py-base) 0 var(--sp-12); }
.cases__head {text-align: center; max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto var(--sp-10); }
/* Tabs filter */
.cases-tabs {display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: var(--sp-2); margin: 0 auto var(--sp-12); max-width: 1080px; }
.cases-tab {appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--neutral-0); color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: var(--font-display, "Inter", sans-serif); font-size: var(--fs-small); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-5); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); white-space: nowrap; }
.cases-tab:hover {border-color: var(--teal-600); color: var(--teal-600); }
.cases-tab.is-active {background: var(--teal-600); border-color: var(--teal-600); color: var(--neutral-0); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); }
/* Таб-ссылка «Все проекты» — ведёт на /proekty/allprojects/, не фильтр */
.cases-tab--link {background: var(--neutral-950); border-color: var(--neutral-950); color: var(--neutral-0); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-2); }
.cases-tab--link:hover {background: var(--teal-700); border-color: var(--teal-700); color: var(--neutral-0); }
.cases-tab--link span {transition: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.cases-tab--link:hover span {transform: translateX(4px); }
/* — Featured case (детали слева + галерея справа) — */
.case-feature {display: none; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 1fr; gap: var(--sp-12); align-items: start; background: var(--neutral-0); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-top: 3px solid var(--teal-600); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(16,31,38,0.15), 0 2px 8px rgba(16,31,38,0.04); padding: var(--sp-10); position: relative; }
.case-feature.is-active {display: grid; }
/* Eyebrow-плашка над заголовком кейса — показывает категорию */
.case-feature__category {font-family: var(--font-display, "Inter", sans-serif); font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow, 0.08em); color: var(--teal-600); margin-bottom: var(--sp-3); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--sp-3); }
.case-feature__category::before {content: ""; width: 24px; height: 2px; background: var(--teal-600); }
/* Кнопка «следующий проект» (legacy) */
button.case-feature__next {appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; }
/* Prev/Next листалка */
.case-feature__nav {display: inline-flex; gap: var(--sp-2); align-items: center; margin-left: auto; }
/* Счётчик «3 / 124» — моноширный, цвета brand teal */
.case-feature__counter {font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-small); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); color: var(--text-tertiary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 0 var(--sp-3); white-space: nowrap; }
/* Ссылка-сноска под фото — теперь это кликабельный link на страницу проекта */
a.case-feature__photo-note {color: var(--text-brand); text-decoration: none; font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); font-style: normal; transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); }
a.case-feature__photo-note:hover {color: var(--teal-700); text-decoration: underline; }
.case-feature__nav-btn {appearance: none; background: var(--neutral-0); border: 1px solid var(--border-default, var(--neutral-200)); color: var(--text-secondary); padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4); font-family: var(--font-display, "Inter", sans-serif); font-size: var(--fs-small); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.case-feature__nav-btn:hover {border-color: var(--teal-600); color: var(--teal-600); background: var(--teal-50, #F0F5F8); }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .case-feature__nav { margin-left: 0; width: 100%; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .case-feature__counter { order: -1; flex-basis: 100%; text-align: center; padding: 0 0 var(--sp-2); }
  .case-feature__nav-btn { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-2); }
}
/* CTA «Смотреть все проекты» — выделенная плашка под кейс-блоком */
.cases-all-cta {margin-top: var(--sp-10); padding: var(--sp-8) var(--sp-10); background: var(--neutral-0); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-left: 3px solid var(--green-500); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--sp-6); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cases-all-cta__text {font-size: var(--fs-lead); color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); line-height: 1.4; margin: 0; }
.cases-all-cta__text strong {color: var(--teal-600); }
.case-feature::before {content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 64px; height: 3px; background: var(--green-500); }
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .case-feature { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--sp-8); padding: var(--sp-8); }
}
.case-feature__title {font-size: var(--fs-h2); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -0.015em; margin: 0 0 var(--sp-6); line-height: 1.2; }
/* meta-pills (Тип / Отрасль / Регион) */
.case-meta {list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 var(--sp-8); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-3); }
.case-meta li {display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--sp-2); background: var(--teal-50, #F0F5F8); padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-4); border-left: 2px solid var(--teal-600); }
.case-meta__label {font-family: var(--font-display, "Inter", sans-serif); font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow, 0.08em); color: var(--text-tertiary); }
.case-meta__value {font-size: var(--fs-small); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); color: var(--text-primary); }
/* Задача / Результат блоки */
.case-block {margin-bottom: var(--sp-6); }
.case-block__label {font-family: var(--font-display, "Inter", sans-serif); font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-bold); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow, 0.08em); color: var(--teal-600); margin-bottom: var(--sp-3); }
.case-block__text {font-size: var(--fs-body); line-height: 1.55; color: var(--text-primary); margin: 0 0 var(--sp-2); }
.case-block__text--muted {color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--fs-small); }
.case-result {list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-3); }
.case-result li {display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--sp-3); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: var(--fs-body); line-height: 1.5; }
.case-result svg {width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--teal-600); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
.case-feature__cta {display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--sp-5); margin-top: var(--sp-8); }
.case-feature__next {color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--fs-small); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); }
.case-feature__next:hover {color: var(--teal-600); }
/* Галерея */
.case-feature__gallery {display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--sp-3); }
.case-feature__main {aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; background: var(--neutral-100); }
.case-feature__main img {width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
/* Модификатор для фото малого разрешения — не растягиваем, центрируем на тёмном фоне */
.case-feature__main--contain {background: var(--neutral-950); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.case-feature__main--contain img {width: auto; height: 100%; max-width: 100%; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast; }
/* Подпись «реальное фото с площадки» — источник */
.case-feature__photo-note {font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-caption); color: var(--text-tertiary); letter-spacing: 0; text-align: right; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.4; }
.case-feature__thumbs {display: flex; gap: var(--sp-2); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.case-feature__thumbs .case-thumb {width: 88px; height: 88px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.case-thumb {appearance: none; padding: 0; border: 2px solid transparent; background: var(--neutral-100); aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
              opacity var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); opacity: 0.7; }
.case-thumb img {width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.case-thumb:hover {opacity: 1; }
.case-thumb.is-active {border-color: var(--teal-600); opacity: 1; }
/* ============================================================
   CASES CAROUSEL — крайние проекты, горизонтальный скролл
   ============================================================ */
.cases-carousel {background: var(--surface-subtle, #F5F7F8); padding: var(--section-py-base) 0; }
.cases-carousel__head {text-align: center; max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto var(--sp-10); }
.carousel {display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(220px, 1fr); gap: var(--sp-5); overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; padding-bottom: var(--sp-5); margin: 0 calc(var(--sp-8) * -1); padding-left: var(--sp-8); padding-right: var(--sp-8); scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--teal-600) transparent; }
.carousel::-webkit-scrollbar {height: 4px; }
.carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {background: var(--teal-600); }
.carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-track {background: var(--neutral-200); }
.carousel-card {scroll-snap-align: start; background: var(--neutral-0); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: transform var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out),
              box-shadow var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out); }
.carousel-card:hover {transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md, 0 8px 24px rgba(16,31,38,0.12)); }
.carousel-card__cover {aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: var(--neutral-100); overflow: hidden; }
.carousel-card__cover img {width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out); }
.carousel-card:hover .carousel-card__cover img {transform: scale(1.04); }
.carousel-card__body {padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-5) var(--sp-5); border-top: 2px solid var(--teal-600); }
.carousel-card__title {font-size: var(--fs-body); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: var(--sp-1); line-height: 1.3; }
.carousel-card__meta {font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-caption); color: var(--text-tertiary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.carousel-progress {max-width: 320px; margin: var(--sp-6) auto 0; }
.carousel-progress__bar {height: 3px; background: var(--neutral-200); position: relative; }
.carousel-progress__bar span {position: absolute; inset: 0 60% 0 0; background: var(--green-500); }
/* ============================================================
   VIDEO SECTION — 3 плитки с play-кнопкой
   ============================================================ */
.video-section {background: var(--neutral-0); padding: var(--section-py-base) 0; }
.video-section__head {text-align: center; max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto var(--sp-10); }
.video-grid {display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--sp-6); }
@media (max-width: 960px) { .video-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
@media (max-width: 640px) { .video-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
